cards.question: What is the insurance value chain?
cards.answer: The insurance value chain encompasses all stages from identifying customer needs and defining products to pricing, underwriting, risk retention, claims, and financial reporting, reflecting the interconnected functions and financial links in the insurance industry.
cards.explanation: The insurance value chain details the sequence of interconnected processes that insurance companies follow to deliver value, from understanding customer needs through to financial reporting.
cards.objective: Define the insurance value chain and understand its components and roles.
